title: A command table
description:
Dispatch typed commands through a table of function pointers.

```
> add 2 3
5
> mul 4 5
20
> pow 2 10
1024
> foo 1 2
unknown command: foo (try add, sub, mul, div, pow)
```
hints: `sizeof commands / sizeof commands[0]` is the number of entries (lesson 6.01).
Division by zero needs a check before calling; add a `int needs_nonzero` field to the table, or check the name.
requirements: `typedef long (*Op)(long, long);` and `struct { const char *name; Op fn; } commands[]`.
Look the name up in the table with a loop; no `if` chain over names.
`div` by zero prints `cannot divide by zero`.
stretch: Make the table hold a help text for each command and print it for `help`.
